metadata.question: In Janaury 2020, did the city of Mahajanga experience more than 12 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation for Jan 2020 over Mahajanga city area (10 km buffer around point [46.3167, -15.7167]). If CHIRPS has no images, fall back to GPM IMERG V06 half-hourly precipitation aggregated to the month.
2. Masking strategy: Not applicable; precipitation datasets are analysis-ready with no cloud masking.
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null: Check collection size (C1), valid pixel count in reduceRegion (C2), and that the computed precipitation is finite and within plausible monthly range [0, 2000] mm (else C3).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  function evaluate(eeObj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      eeObj.evaluate((v, err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(v)));
    });
  }

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Point([46.3167, -15.7167]).buffer(10000); // Mahajanga, MG ~10 km
    const start = ee.Date('2020-01-01');
    const end = ee.Date('2020-02-01');
    const thresholdMm = 304.8; // 12 inches in mm

    // 2. Data Acquisition: CHIRPS first
    let datasetUsed = 'CHIRPS';
    let precipSumImg = null;
    let imgCount = 0;

    const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .select(['precipitation']);
    imgCount = await evaluate(chirps.size());
    console.log(`CHIRPS Images (Jan 2020): ${imgCount}`);

    if (imgCount === 0) {
      // Fallback to GPM IMERG V06 half-hourly
      const gpm = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .select(['precipitationCal']); // mm/hr
      const gpmCount = await evaluate(gpm.size());
      console.log(`GPM IMERG Images (Jan 2020): ${gpmCount}`);
      if (gpmCount === 0) {
        console.log('No images found for both datasets.');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection'); // final tag line
        return;
      }
      datasetUsed = 'GPM_IMERG';
      // Convert mm/hr to mm per 30 min by *0.5, then sum across month
      const gpmMm = gpm.map(img => img.multiply(0.5).rename('precip_mm')); // mm per 30-min step
      precipSumImg = gpmMm.sum(); // total mm over month
    } else {
      // Sum daily mm over month
      precipSumImg = chirps.sum().rename('precipitation').rename('precip_mm');
    }

    // 3. Pixel count to detect C2
    const scale = datasetUsed === 'CHIRPS' ? 5000 : 10000;
    const countDict = await evaluate(
      precipSumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      })
    );
    const count = countDict ? (countDict.precip_mm || 0) : 0;
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}, Valid Pixels: ${count}, Scale: ${scale} m`);
    if (!count || count === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after processing.');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels'); // final tag line
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: area-mean total rainfall (mm) for Jan 2020
    const meanDict = await evaluate(
      precipSumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      })
    );
    const mm = meanDict ? meanDict.precip_mm : null;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if (mm === null || !isFinite(mm) || mm < 0 || mm > 2000) {
      console.log(`Mean(mm): ${mm}`);
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure'); // final tag line
      return;
    }
    const inches = mm / 25.4;
    console.log(`Jan 2020 Rainfall (area-mean): ${mm.toFixed(1)} mm (${inches.toFixed(2)} in)`);
    console.log(`Threshold: 304.8 mm (12 in)`);

    const moreThan12in = inches > 12.0;
    console.log(`Exceeds 12 inches: ${moreThan12in}`);
    if (moreThan12in) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
